category_title: Third-grade students with E/BD exhibiting externalizing disruptive behaviors during reading
student_description: This is a third-grade student with emotional/behavioral disturbance (E/BD) who exhibits high rates of externalizing, disruptive behaviors (e.g., talking over the teacher, making noises, work refusal) during academic tasks. They are nonresponsive to standard schoolwide behavioral expectations and uniquely require a highly structured Check-In, Check-Out (CICO) system with frequent, individualized feedback to regulate their behavior.

criteria.rationale: Sustained behavioral improvement for this student relies on bookending the day with structured goal-setting and reflection.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must establish a consistent daily routine where the student meets with an adult at the beginning of the day to set expectations and at the end of the day to review progress.

criteria.rationale: The student requires a consistent, supportive relationship outside of standard classroom instruction to anchor their behavioral interventions.
criteria.check: The long-term plan must assign a specific, consistent adult (such as a counselor or dedicated mentor) to oversee the student's behavioral tracking and provide individualized support.
